newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA September commodity index down 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA September commodity index down 0.2 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia's commodity price index for September fell 0.2 percent in Special Drawing Rights terms after falling 0.4 percent in August.

Falls in prices of wheat and aluminium were partly offset by a rise in crude oil prices, the Reserve Bank said in a statement. In Australian dollar terms, the index was was down 2.0 percent following a rise of 1.1 percent in August, it said.
